effect_status_semantics.PREFLIGHT_NO_EFFECT: Rejected or failed before the named target mutation; counts are exact zero for the prevented effect.
effect_status_semantics.COMPLETED: The named route/read/mutation or target attempt completed as described.
effect_status_semantics.UNKNOWN_INCONCLUSIVE: Transport ended after dispatch and completion cannot be inferred; remain INCONCLUSIVE until the specified authoritative reconciliation read.
